newsitem.title: ITALY: 280,000 Italians sign petition to ban landmines.
newsitem.headline: 280,000 Italians sign petition to ban landmines.

text.p: An Italian group pressing for a worldwide ban on the production and use of landmines presented President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro on Thursday with a petition signed by 280,000 people backing their campaign.
Four people injured by landmines during the war in Bosnia accompanied the group to the meeting with Scalfaro, his office said in a statement.
Over 100 million landmines lie buried in 64 countries around the world. According to U.N. statistics, landmines kill or maim someone every 20 minutes, or 25,000 people a year.
Last year Canada launched the so-called "Ottawa Process" which aims to achieve a legally-binding agreement by the end of this year to ban the production, stockpiling, export and use of landmines.
